question: Who is the editor of the book 'Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh Through the Ages' of the Indian Council Historical Research (ICHR)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raghuvendra Tanwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raghuvendra Tanwar** is the editor of the book **'Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh Through the Ages'**, published under the auspices of the **Indian Council of Historical Research (ICHR)**.
 
• The book is a significant scholarly work that delves into the history, culture, and politics of the **Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh regions**, providing insights into their evolution through different eras.
 
• Dr. Raghuvendra Tanwar is a noted historian, known for his expertise in the history of **Jammu and Kashmir**, and has contributed extensively to the understanding of this critical region of India.
 
• The book aims to provide an **academic perspective** on the historical and socio-political transformations of the region, along with its cultural and geographical significance.
 
• The Indian Council of Historical Research (ICHR) is a premier academic body under the **Ministry of Education, Government of India**, dedicated to promoting historical research and publications.
 
• This work is a part of the ICHR's efforts to present a balanced and well-researched account of the historical developments in the **Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh** regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Book:**

 
 
• **'Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh Through the Ages'** explores the **geopolitical, historical, and cultural evolution** of the region.
 
• The book is a comprehensive work that discusses the impact of various rulers, communities, and socio-political changes in shaping the region's identity.
 
 
 
• **About Raghuvendra Tanwar:**
 
 
• Dr. Raghuvendra Tanwar is a **renowned historian** and an expert on **Indian history**, particularly on the subject of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• He has written extensively about the region and its historical complexities, focusing on topics such as the **partition, Article 370, and socio-political conflicts**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Council of Historical Research (ICHR):**
 
 
• ICHR is an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Education, Government of India**, established to promote and foster historical research.
 
• It funds and publishes works that are **academically rigorous** and contribute to the understanding of Indian history.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Themes in the Book:**

 
 
• The book covers major aspects of the **historical and cultural developments** in Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh, including their integration into India.
 
• It provides insights into the **geostrategic importance of the region** and its role in contemporary Indian politics and history.
 
 
 
• **Notable Contributions:**
 
 
• Dr. Raghuvendra Tanwar has significantly contributed to the study of **partition-era history**, focusing on the events leading to the division of India and Pakistan.
 
• He has also been involved in research on **India's strategic and cultural history**, with particular emphasis on sensitive regions like Jammu and Kashmir.
